name: blender
description: Create game assets in Blender and export GLB files into the project.

interface.shortDescription: Make game assets and export project-ready GLB files.
interface.longDescription: The main Agent uses local Blender to create models and animations, check each stage and repair defects. Rotate the finished model and play its animations on the Canvas, then accept it or request changes. You can also ask to review an intermediate stage. The workflow preserves editable Blender files and exports GLB for the target project.
defaultPrompt: Create a low-poly game prop in Blender and export it as GLB into this project.
Prepare this Blender asset for the project and verify its GLB export.
